title_en: The Greatest Messenger (peace be upon him and his family) in Umayyad Heritage and Islamic Heritage (Episode 22)
summary: This lecture by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari investigates accounts of the Prophet Muhammad within Islamic and Umayyad heritage.
